caches.title: Caches
caches.description: What Toskar keeps to answer repeats faster. Personal caches stay on this computer and are cleared with run records. Passwords and keys are never cached.

abilities.title: What Toskar can do
abilities.description: From what is installed, online, and connected right now. Chat answers questions such as “Can you generate an image?” from this list.

providers.title: Tools on each computer
providers.description: Images and speech run on whichever paired computer can run them, preferring one whose GPU does the work. Files are sent to it for the job and the result comes back to this chat.

memory.title: Toskar's memory
memory.description: How much memory Toskar itself uses, and its background tasks. Both should level off after a while; steady growth over hours is worth reporting.
